input.title: Add TSV support to report export functionality
input.body:
File: src/api/reports.ts

The current report export system supports CSV and XLSX formats but lacks TSV support. Since the warehouse loader requires tab-delimited files, adding TSV export would eliminate manual conversion errors caused by commas in transaction descriptions. The change should extend the `renderExport` function to handle TSV generation, similar to how CSV and XLSX are handled, and update the `SUPPORTED_FORMATS` enum to include TSV.
